title: Modified DAP-seq Protocol for Cannabis sativa Transcription Factors
author: Lee J. Conneely
materials: During the expression reaction, prepare HALO magnetic beads.
To each tube of transcription factor-bound HALO beads, add: 5 µL sheared salmon sperm DNA , 2 µg/µL 100 ng adapter-ligated genomic DNA library Qiagen EB buffer to a final volume of 100 µL
Roll out bubbles carefully at each layer.
Immediately place denatured salmon sperm DNA on ice.
Allow the beads to settle briefly.
Immediately place the tubes on ice.
For the final elution, elute purified DAP-seq libraries in 12 µL Qiagen EB buffer instead of the larger elution volume recommended in the kit protocol.

steps.title: Prepare Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate at least 30 µg of high-quality genomic DNA from the tissue of interest, pooling preparations if required and quantifying with Qubit.

steps.title: Shear Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Shear the genomic DNA using a Diagenode Bioruptor to achieve a fragment distribution peak of ~200 bp (suitable range 160–200 bp).

substeps.instruction: Ensure the cooling system is on and water has reached 4°C before starting.
Prepare six low-bind microcentrifuge tubes, each containing 100 µL genomic DNA at 50 ng/µL; keep on ice.
Shear on the high setting with 30 s on / 30 s off intervals for 20 min.
Remove tubes and place immediately on ice.
Assess fragmentation for each tube individually using a D1000 or D5000 ScreenTape.
If insufficiently sheared, return to Bioruptor for an additional 10–20 min using the same settings, ensuring all positions are occupied (use 100 µL water to balance if necessary).
Repeat assessment and shearing until all six tubes show the desired distribution.

steps.title: Perform Adapter Ligation and Size Selection
steps.instruction: Prepare an adapter-ligated library using the NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit (E7645S).

substeps.instruction: Perform up to 30 ligation reactions using a maximum of 1 µg (20 µL) of sheared gDNA per reaction.
Perform double-sided size selection using kit conditions for 150 bp or 200 bp insert size (150 bp was used in this protocol).
For the final elution of size-selected library from SPRIselect beads, elute in EB buffer for 10 min (instead of 2 min) to improve recovery.
Assess each size-selected, adapter-ligated library using a D1000 or D5000 ScreenTape.
Pool the adapter-ligated libraries into a single low-bind microcentrifuge tube.
Run the pooled library on a D1000 or D5000 ScreenTape for final reference (expected average insert size ~150 bp + 150 bp adapter content).
Store the pooled library at −20°C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Express transcription factors or HALO empty-vector controls using the TNT Wheat Germ system.

substeps.instruction: Prepare pIX-HALO plasmid DNA for each construct using a midi-prep kit (e.g., Qiagen or Promega), aiming for 9–10 µg in 20 µL (450–500 ng/µL). Store at −20°C.
For each reaction, combine 20 µL pIX-HALO plasmid DNA and 30 µL TNT Wheat Germ Master Mix (450–500 ng/µL).
Incubate the reaction at 25°C for 2 h.
Store the remaining 10 µL of each expression reaction at −20°C for optional western blot QC.

steps.title: Prepare HALO Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Wash and aliquot HALO magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Place beads on a magnetic rack and remove the storage buffer.
Wash the beads three times with an equal volume of PBS + 0.05% NP-40.
Transfer the required volume of HALO magnetic beads to a low-bind microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Bind Protein to Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the expressed protein to the HALO beads.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 20 µL bead suspension into each PCR tube.
Add 40 µL of the corresponding wheat germ expression reaction to each bead aliquot.
Add 50 µL PBS + 0.05% NP-40 to each bead aliquot.
Cap tubes and invert by hand 5–10 times to mix.
Rotate tubes end-over-end for 1 h at low-to-medium speed (ensure liquid travels fully between ends).
Place tubes on a magnetic rack, allow beads to collect, and remove the supernatant (retain if unbound protein assessment is desired).

steps.title: Wash and Elute DAP-seq DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the protein-bead complex and elute the bound DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL PBS + 0.05% NP-40 to each tube, allow beads to settle, place on magnetic rack, and discard wash buffer.
Repeat the protein/bead wash for a total of four washes.
After the final wash, resuspend the beads in 40 µL PBS + 0.05% NP-40.
Transfer the full bead suspension to a fresh strip of PCR tubes during the final wash.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack and remove the final wash buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 16 µL Qiagen EB buffer by gently pipetting up and down.
Cap tubes and heat at 98°C for 10 min to release bound DNA.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack, allow beads to collect, and transfer 15 µL supernatant to a new PCR tube for indexing PCR.

steps.title: Perform DNA Wash and Indexing
steps.instruction: Perform final DNA washes and library indexing.

substeps.instruction: Denature sheared salmon sperm DNA at 98°C for 10 min.
Mix the solution by inverting by hand 5–10 times until homogeneous.
Rotate tubes end-over-end for 1 h at low-to-medium speed.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack, remove and discard supernatant.
Add 100 µL PBS + 0.05% NP-40 to each tube, allow beads to settle, place on magnetic rack, and discard wash buffer.
Repeat the DNA/protein/bead wash for a total of five washes.
Continue the NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit protocol using 15 µL recovered DAP-seq DNA as input for indexing PCR, following the setup exactly.
Perform post-PCR cleanup according to the NEBNext Ultra II protocol.
Store final indexed DAP-seq libraries at −20°C.

steps.title: Quality Control and Analysis
steps.instruction: Assess the final libraries and perform protein QC via Western Blot.

substeps.instruction: Assess final DAP-seq libraries using a D1000 ScreenTape and compare transcription factor libraries with the HALO empty-vector control.
For Western Blot QC: Thaw the retained wheat germ expression reaction aliquot on ice.
Prepare samples by mixing 1 µL wheat germ expression reaction with 1 µL 2× Laemmli buffer.
Load 4 µL protein ladder and 0.5 µL of each denatured sample onto a 4–15% Criterion TGX Stain-Free Protein Gel; run at 100 V for 90 min.
Prepare blocking solution (2.5 g skim milk powder in 50 mL 1× TBS), warm to 60°C to dissolve, then cool to room temperature.
Wet transfer stacks and nitrocellulose membrane with Turbo transfer buffer.
Assemble transfer stack in Turbo transfer drawer: wet transfer stack, nitrocellulose membrane, gel, wet transfer stack.
Run the transfer using the default Turbo transfer program; confirm ladder transfer.
Add blocking solution and rock gently for 1 h at room temperature (no orbital shaker).
Prepare primary antibody (1:2,500 in 0.1% TBST), add to membrane, and incubate overnight at 4°C with gentle rocking (no orbital shaker).
Wash membrane 3 × 10 min with 0.1% TBST.
Prepare secondary antibody (1:20,000 in 0.1% TBST) and incubate for 1 h at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Wash membrane 3 × 20 min with 0.1% TBST.
Prepare SuperSignal West Pico PLUS substrate (mix 2 mL bottle A + 2 mL bottle B), apply evenly to the membrane on plastic film/bag.
Image using ChemiDoc: acquire colorimetric blot image for ladder (e.g., 0.1 s), then chemiluminescent image (starting at 0.1 s), and merge the images.
